---
name: render-probe
description: [probe] reviews a diff: names the file, quotes the "line", flags a # comment
tier: cheap or mid
---


# Render probe

A body that starts after two blank lines, so the render has to trim them.

- an item with a `backtick` in it
- an item with a backslash \ in it
- an item with a "quote" and a # hash
